steps.title: Web QA — Playwright harness, smoke suite and CI
steps.goal: `apps/web` gains a Playwright 1.62 harness (`apps/web/playwright.config.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/*`) that builds and starts the web app under a committed mock environment — no Supabase project, Stripe or network — and asserts that public pages render, forms validate, every `/admin` and `/o/*` route redirects anonymous visitors to `/login?next=…`, `/s/unknown` is a 404, the DESIGN §9 security headers are present on ordinary pages and correctly relaxed on `/s/*` and `/embed/*`, `/api/cron/tick` and `/api/stripe/webhook` refuse unauthenticated or unsigned calls, and no secret value appears in HTML. The same suite runs against a deployed URL via `BASE_URL`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs it on every push, and `pnpm --filter web build` is warning-free. The env-gated full E2E, the accessibility pass and the states audit are 3.7b.
steps.prompt:
You are working in the ChurchAppCLD repository. CLAUDE.md loads `new_session_instructions.md` and `HANDOFF.md` automatically — follow the session-start checklist (new-session.sh, prompt_history.txt). Work on `main` unless I have named another branch in this session. This is step 3.7a "Web QA — Playwright harness, smoke suite and CI" of `docs/TODO.md`; read that step's 'Done when' list first. Read `docs/PLAN.md` §7–§8 and §12, and `docs/DESIGN.md` §8–§9, §11 (Phase 1 step 9, the Acceptance paragraph) and §12 before writing code. Build ONLY this step; do not start the next one.

## Goal
When you finish, `apps/web` has a Playwright 1.62 harness that runs the whole web app against a **mock environment** with no Supabase project, no Stripe and no network: `pnpm --filter web test:e2e:smoke` builds the app, starts it, and asserts that every public page renders, that form validation works, that every protected route redirects anonymous visitors to `/login?next=…`, that `/s/unknown` is a 404, that the security headers documented in DESIGN §9 are present on ordinary pages and correctly relaxed on `/s/*` and `/embed/*`, that the cron and webhook routes refuse unauthenticated or unsigned calls, and that no secret value ever reaches HTML. The same suite runs against a deployed URL when `BASE_URL` is set (step 2.5's helper and step 3.9 use this). `.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs the smoke suite on every push. `pnpm --filter web build` is warning-free. The env-gated full E2E, the accessibility pass and the empty/loading/error-state audit are step 3.7b — do not start them.

## Inputs / prior state
- Web app (steps 2.1a–3.6b, all ticked in `HANDOFF.md`): `apps/web` (package name `web`, Next 16.3, React 19.2.3, Tailwind 4, shadcn/ui, Vitest 4). Read `apps/web/next.config.ts` (two security-header variants — the default set with `X-Frame-Options: DENY` and `frame-ancestors 'none'`, and the `/(s|embed)/:path*` set with `frame-ancestors *`, `X-Robots-Tag: noindex`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, no X-Frame-Options), `apps/web/proxy.ts` (protected paths exactly `/admin`, `/admin/*`, `/o`, `/o/*`; matcher excludes `/api/stripe/webhook`, `/api/cron/tick`, `/s/*`, `/embed/*`, static assets), `apps/web/src/lib/env.ts` (`publicEnv()`, `serverEnv()` — throws for missing required variables; `stripeConfigured()` reads `process.env` directly), `apps/web/src/lib/security/csp.ts`, and `apps/web/.env.example`.
- Routes that exist (PLAN §8 / DESIGN §9): `(public)` `/`, `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/s/[token]`, `/embed/yt/[id]`; `(auth)` `/login`, `/signup`, `/auth/callback`, `/auth/reset`, `/invite/[token]`; `(super)` `/admin/*`; `(org)` `/o/[orgSlug]/{dashboard,sermons,sermons/new,sermons/[id],announcements,announcements/new,announcements/[id]/edit,bulletins,users,users/[membershipId],invitations,settings,settings/billing}`; `api/` `stripe/webhook`, `billing/checkout`, `billing/portal`, `share/[token]/unlock`, `cron/tick`.
- Earlier prompts left instructions for this step: 3.4b says `/s/unknown` must stay 404 with the mock env; 3.6b says `GET /api/cron/tick` without a header returns 401 when `CRON_SECRET` is set and 503 when it is not — this step sets a mock `CRON_SECRET`, so assert 401. 3.2a, 3.2b, 3.5a and 3.5b each asked for a signed-out redirect assertion on their pages (`/o/some-church/users`, `/o/some-church/invitations`, `/o/unknown/announcements`, `/o/unknown/bulletins`) — include them all. 2.6's `docs/DEPLOY.md` (if it exists) tells triage runs to add smoke assertions only once `apps/web/playwright.config.ts` exists — this step creates it.
- CI: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` from step 1.1 (one non-blocking job `checks`; later steps are guarded with `hashFiles(...)`; the web build step already passes the mock env `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=http://localhost:54321`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=sb_publishable_ci_placeholder`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3000`).
- Tooling on this machine: Node 22, pnpm 10, Playwright + Chromium already installed (`npx playwright --version`). Do not assume Docker or a hosted Supabase project.
- Pins (PLAN §3 / DESIGN §3): `@playwright/test` 1.62.x. Confirm with `npm view @playwright/test version` that the 1.62 line exists; never bump the major.

## Build
1. **Dependencies and scripts.** In `apps/web/package.json` add devDependency `@playwright/test` ~1.62 (exact minor from `npm view`). Add scripts: `test:e2e` → `playwright test`, `test:e2e:smoke` → `playwright test --project=smoke`, `test:e2e:full` → `playwright test --project=full` (the `full` project is defined in 3.7b; define the script now so the docs are stable), `test:e2e:report` → `playwright show-report`. Do NOT add Playwright to the `test` script or to Turbo's `test` task — `pnpm turbo lint typecheck test` must stay fast and network-free. Add a Turbo task `e2e` in `turbo.json` (`cache: false`, `dependsOn: ["^build"]`, `env` list identical to `build` plus `BASE_URL`, `E2E_*`) so `pnpm turbo e2e --filter web` works. Add `apps/web/playwright-report/`, `apps/web/test-results/` and `apps/web/e2e/.auth/` to `.gitignore`.
2. **`apps/web/playwright.config.ts`** (package root; `testDir: './e2e'`; DESIGN §11 step 9 writes `apps/web/e2e/playwright.config.ts` — put the config at the package root so `pnpm --filter web exec playwright test` finds it without flags, and note the wording in HANDOFF). Contents:
   - `const baseURL = process.env.BASE_URL ?? 'http://localhost:3100'`; `webServer` only when `BASE_URL` is unset: `command: 'pnpm build && pnpm start -- --port 3100'` run in `apps/web`, `url: baseURL`, `reuseExistingServer: !process.env.CI`, `timeout: 240_000`, and `env` = the **mock environment** defined in one place, `apps/web/e2e/mock-env.ts` (exported object, also re-used by 3.7b): `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=http://localhost:54321`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=sb_publishable_ci_placeholder`, `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY=sb_secret_mock_value_must_never_appear_in_html`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3100`, `SHARE_LINK_COOKIE_SECRET=<a 44-character base64 literal generated once and committed — it protects nothing>`, `CRON_SECRET=mock-cron-secret`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_MAX_UPLOAD_MB=50`, and NO `STRIPE_*` / `RESEND_*` (so the Stripe banner, the webhook 503 and the copy-link invitation path are exercised). Build with the mock env too: `next build` must succeed with these values (2.1a designed `serverEnv()` for exactly this).
   - `projects`: `smoke` (`testMatch: /smoke\.spec\.ts/`, Chromium desktop) and `smoke-mobile` (same files, `devices['Pixel 7']`) — the responsive pass costs nothing extra. Leave a commented `full` project placeholder for 3.7b.
   - `use`: `baseURL`, `trace: 'retain-on-failure'`, `screenshot: 'only-on-failure'`, `video: 'off'`; `reporter: [['list'], ['html', { open: 'never' }]]`; `forbidOnly: !!process.env.CI`; `retries: process.env.CI ? 1 : 0`; `workers: process.env.CI ? 2 : undefined`; `expect.timeout: 10_000`.
3. **Helpers — `apps/web/e2e/helpers/headers.ts`** exporting `expectStrictHeaders(response)` (asserts `content-security-policy` contains `frame-ancestors 'none'` and `frame-src https://www.youtube-nocookie.com https://drive.google.com`, `strict-transport-security` present, `referrer-policy` present, `x-content-type-options: nosniff`, `x-frame-options: DENY`) and `expectShareHeaders(response)` (CSP contains `frame-ancestors *`, `x-robots-tag` contains `noindex`, `referrer-policy: no-referrer`, header `x-frame-options` absent). `apps/web/e2e/helpers/routes.ts` exporting `PROTECTED_PATHS` = `['/admin', '/admin/churches/new', '/admin/fellowships', '/admin/super-admins', '/o', '/o/some-church', '/o/some-church/dashboard', '/o/some-church/users', '/o/some-church/invitations', '/o/unknown/announcements', '/o/unknown/bulletins', '/o/some-church/sermons', '/o/some-church/sermons/new', '/o/some-church/settings', '/o/some-church/settings/billing']` and `PUBLIC_PATHS` = `['/', '/privacy', '/terms', '/login', '/signup', '/auth/reset']`.
4. **`apps/web/e2e/smoke.spec.ts`** — one `test.describe` per area, every test independent, no shared state, no sleeps (use `expect(...).toHaveURL`, `toBeVisible`, `toPass`):
   1. *Public pages render*: for each of `PUBLIC_PATHS`, `page.goto` → status 200, exactly one `h1` visible, `<html lang="en">`, a non-empty `<title>`, no `console.error` entries (collect via `page.on('console')`, ignore the known Next dev-only noise only if the app is running `next dev` — it is not, so expect zero), no failed requests to first-party URLs (`page.on('requestfailed')`; requests to `localhost:54321` may fail and are expected — filter them out and assert they never block rendering).
   2. *Unauthenticated redirects*: for each of `PROTECTED_PATHS`, `page.goto(path)` ends at `/login?next=<encodeURIComponent(path)>`; `request.get(path, { maxRedirects: 0 })` returns 307 or 308 with a `location` header starting with `/login?next=`. Also assert `/other`, `/privacy` and `/s/unknown` are NOT redirected.
   3. *Login form validation*: on `/login` submit empty → the email field shows its error text (find the `aria-describedby` target or the shadcn `FormMessage`); type `not-an-email` → an invalid-email message; type a valid email and a password → the request to `localhost:54321` fails → the page shows the mapped generic error text from `src/lib/supabase/errors.ts` (read that module and assert the exact string, not a regex) and never a raw stack trace. If OTP mode exists, toggle it and assert the code field appears only after "Send code". `/signup` gets the same empty-submit and invalid-email checks.
   4. *Share and embed*: `request.get('/s/unknown')` → 404 with `expectShareHeaders`; `page.goto('/s/unknown')` shows the "link not available" copy from 3.4b (read `app/(public)/s/[token]/page.tsx` for the exact text). `request.post('/api/share/unknown/unlock', { form: { password: 'whatever' } })` → 404 or 400 (read `app/api/share/[token]/unlock/route.ts` and assert the documented code), never 500. `request.get('/embed/yt/dQw4w9WgXcQ')` → 200, `expectShareHeaders`, body contains `youtube-nocookie.com/embed/dQw4w9WgXcQ`; `/embed/yt/not-eleven-chars` → 404.
   5. *Security headers*: `expectStrictHeaders` on `/`, `/privacy`, `/login` and on the redirect response of `/admin`; `expectShareHeaders` on `/s/unknown` and `/embed/yt/dQw4w9WgXcQ`. Assert `/privacy` HTML contains no `<script src=` pointing at a host other than the app itself (CSP `script-src` sanity).
   6. *Operational routes refuse strangers*: `GET /api/cron/tick` without header → 401 (mock `CRON_SECRET` is set); with `Authorization: Bearer wrong` → 401; `GET /api/cron/tick?secret=mock-cron-secret` → 401 (query string never accepted — 3.6b). `POST /api/stripe/webhook` with any body → 503 (no `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`) and the body says Stripe is not configured (read 2.3's route for the exact text). `POST /api/billing/checkout` and `POST /api/billing/portal` anonymous → 401 or a redirect to `/login`, never 500. `GET /api/cron/tick` response has `cache-control: no-store` if 3.6b set it (read the route; assert what it does).
   7. *No secret in HTML*: for `/`, `/login`, `/privacy`, `/s/unknown`, `/embed/yt/dQw4w9WgXcQ` the response body does not contain `sb_secret_`, `service_role`, `mock-cron-secret`, or the `SHARE_LINK_COOKIE_SECRET` literal. Also fetch every `<script src>` of `/login` that is same-origin and assert the same on those chunks (the mock `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY` value is unique enough to grep for).
   8. *Not found*: `/definitely-not-a-route` → 404 rendered by `app/not-found.tsx` (assert the copy), `expectStrictHeaders`.
5. **`apps/web/e2e/README.md`**: how to run (`pnpm --filter web test:e2e:smoke`; against a deployment `BASE_URL=https://<VERCEL_URL> pnpm --filter web test:e2e:smoke`), what the mock env is and why it is safe to commit, how to open the report, where 3.7b's full suite plugs in (`E2E_*` variables from `docs/ENV.md`), and the rule "a failing smoke test blocks a push; fix the app or the test in the same commit".
6. **CI.** In `.github/workflows/ci.yml` add, after the web build step and guarded with `if: hashFiles('apps/web/playwright.config.ts') != ''`: `pnpm --filter web exec playwright install --with-deps chromium` (cache `~/.cache/ms-playwright` keyed on the Playwright version), then `pnpm --filter web test:e2e:smoke` with `CI=true`, then `actions/upload-artifact@v4` of `apps/web/playwright-report` with `if: failure()` and `retention-days: 7`. The workflow stays `continue-on-error: true` (step 1.1's decision) — do not make it blocking here; 3.8 documents the policy.
7. **Warning-free build.** Run `pnpm --filter web build` with the mock env and fix every warning the build prints (unused exports, `next/image` hints, `metadata` warnings, edge/node runtime notices, dynamic-server-usage messages caused by reading cookies in a static page). Fix the cause, never suppress with `eslint-disable` or `// @ts-expect-error`. Record the list of warnings you removed in `session_log.md`.
8. **Smoke-test hooks in the app, only where needed.** If an assertion needs a stable selector, prefer accessible roles and labels (`getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })`, `getByLabel('Email')`); add `data-testid` only when no accessible handle exists, named `<feature>-<element>` (for example `share-unavailable`). Never change behaviour to make a test pass; if a test exposes a real defect (a protected page not redirecting, a header missing, a 500 on an anonymous API call) fix the defect in the owning module and add a Vitest unit test next to the existing ones.

## Constraints
- Mock env only: no Supabase project, no Stripe key, no Resend key, no network. If a test needs a real backend it belongs in 3.7b's `full` project, not here.
- Do not add Playwright to Turbo's `test` task, do not run it in `pnpm turbo lint typecheck test`, and do not introduce `sleep`/`waitForTimeout` calls.
- Pins: `@playwright/test` 1.62 line; no other new runtime dependency. Chromium only (Firefox/WebKit are not installed on the founder's machines and add nothing for this app).
- Do not refactor pages, guards, headers or API routes beyond fixing a defect a test proved. Do not touch `supabase/`, `packages/*` behaviour, or mobile. Never `supabase db push`/`db reset`.
- No real email address, key, token or domain in tests or docs — use the mock values and `<VERCEL_URL>`.
- Keep `continue-on-error: true` on the CI job (1.1 decided the workflow is informational).

## Verify
- `pnpm install` → lockfile updated with `@playwright/test` only; `npx playwright --version` → 1.62.x.
- `pnpm turbo lint typecheck test` → green (the e2e files are type-checked by `apps/web/tsconfig.json` — include `e2e/**/*.ts` and `playwright.config.ts` in it; exclude them from Vitest's `include`).
- `pnpm --filter web build` with the mock env exported → exit 0 and zero warnings in the output.
- `pnpm --filter web test:e2e:smoke` → all tests pass in both `smoke` and `smoke-mobile`; runtime under 3 minutes after the build; `apps/web/playwright-report/index.html` is produced; `git status` shows no report or `test-results` files.
- Deliberately break one thing locally without committing (comment out the `X-Frame-Options` header in `next.config.ts`) → `test:e2e:smoke` fails on the headers test; restore it.
- `BASE_URL=http://localhost:3100 pnpm --filter web test:e2e:smoke` with the server already running from `pnpm --filter web start -- --port 3100` → passes without starting a second server.
- After pushing, the GitHub Actions run shows the Playwright step executed (green) and no artifact was uploaded.

## Finish
- `HANDOFF.md`: under State add "Web QA: Playwright harness + smoke (3.7a) — done; full E2E/a11y/states audit in 3.7b"; under "Version pins worth remembering" add the Playwright version; under "Deviations from plan" note the config location `apps/web/playwright.config.ts` (DESIGN §11 step 9 draws it under `e2e/`) and that the smoke `CRON_SECRET` is set (so the cron route is asserted as 401, not 503); list any defect the suite exposed and how it was fixed.
- Tick step 3.7a in `docs/TODO.md`; write `session_log.md`; commit `test(web): Playwright harness, mock-env smoke suite and CI step`; push `main` (`git push origin main`) unless another branch was named.
- If anything in the plan proves impossible or wrong (for example a route that cannot render under the mock env), do the closest correct thing, record it in HANDOFF.md under "Deviations from plan", and report it in your final message.

steps.title: Web QA — env-gated full E2E, accessibility and state audit
steps.goal: The Playwright `full` project encodes PLAN §12's acceptance script against a real Supabase project — super admin creates a church → creates its first admin directly → the admin creates a member and toggles permissions → uploads a small mp3 → publishes → password share link → anonymous unlock (no Download button until `sermon_share_allow_download` is on) → org disables sharing → 404 — plus a member-without-permissions security spec; it is skipped cleanly when `E2E_*` is absent, runs locally or against `BASE_URL`, and cleans up its run-tagged churches and `example.invalid` users. Every shipped page passes an axe WCAG 2.0 A/AA scan with no serious/critical violations and a manual labels/focus/contrast pass; every route group has `loading.tsx`, `error.tsx`, `not-found.tsx` and every list page an explicit empty state, recorded in `docs/QA_WEB.md`.

## Build
1. **Config.** In `apps/web/playwright.config.ts` add project `full`: `testMatch: /full\/.*\.spec\.ts/`, Chromium desktop, `fullyParallel: false`, `workers: 1`, `timeout: 120_000`, `retries: 0`. 3. **Runner-side helpers — `apps/web/e2e/full/supabase-admin.ts`** (Node only, imports `@supabase/supabase-js` with the secret key): `createRunTag()` → `e2e-<yyyymmdd>-<6 random chars>`; `cleanupRun(tag)` → deletes `organizations` whose `slug` starts with the tag (cascade removes settings, memberships, sermons, share links; storage objects become orphans for the 3.6b sweep — say so in the README) and deletes `auth.users` whose email matches `<tag>+*@example.invalid` via `auth.admin.listUsers` + `deleteUser`. Use `example.invalid` addresses only (RFC 2606); never a real domain. `apps/web/e2e/full/ui.ts`: `signIn(page, email, password)` (password mode of `/login`), `signOut(page)`, `expectToast(page, text)`.
4. **`apps/web/e2e/full/01-acceptance.spec.ts`** — `test.describe.serial`, one shared `tag`, `afterAll` → `cleanupRun(tag)`. Steps, each its own `test.step` with a clear name:

Assert it is never shown again after closing the dialog.

Assert the admin's own row cannot lose `users.edit_permissions` when it is the only holder (the last-manager error copy from 3.2a is shown) — read `MembershipActions`/`PermissionGrid` for exact wording.

Admin creates an announcement at `/o/<tag>/announcements/new` (title `E2E announcement`, audience "All attendees", push on) → list shows the queued/delivered push status badge from 3.6a (no device is registered, so assert the badge exists and its text is one of the documented labels, not a specific one).

Record the audit as a table in `docs/QA_WEB.md` (route | empty | loading | error | a11y scan | notes) with a row per route and fix every gap in the owning feature folder.
8. **`docs/QA_WEB.md`** (new): how to run smoke and full suites (local server vs `BASE_URL`), the `E2E_*` variables and which key `E2E_SUPABASE_KEY` is, the fixture, what the full suite creates and how `cleanupRun` removes it (and the storage orphan note), the audit table from item 7, and a "Before every checkpoint" paragraph pointing to 3.8's `docs/ACCEPTANCE_WEB.md`. Update `apps/web/e2e/README.md` to link to it and `docs/ENV.md` rows for the `E2E_*` variables (who: founder or agent with the hosted project; where: local shell / `apps/web/.env.e2e` gitignored; never Vercel).
9. **CI.** In `.github/workflows/ci.yml` the smoke step from 3.7a is unchanged. Add a commented block showing how to run the full suite from GitHub with repository secrets (`E2E_*`, `BASE_URL`) — commented out, because the founder has not stored secrets in GitHub and the full suite mutates the hosted project.

## Constraints
- The full suite must be idempotent and self-cleaning: unique `tag` per run, `example.invalid` emails only, `afterAll` cleanup even when a step fails (`test.afterAll` runs regardless). Never touch rows whose slug does not start with the run tag. Never run it against a project the founder has real members in without saying so in `docs/QA_WEB.md` (it creates and deletes churches and auth users).
- Mock env and smoke tests stay network-free. `pnpm turbo lint typecheck test` must not run Playwright.
- Pins: `@playwright/test` 1.62 (already present), `@axe-core/playwright` 4.x. No other new dependency; no `ffmpeg` requirement for anyone but the one-time fixture generation.
- Fix accessibility and state gaps in the owning components with the smallest change; do not redesign pages, do not add a component library, do not change the neutral theme's colours except the contrast/focus tokens the audit requires (record every token you changed).
- Do not change RLS, migrations or `packages/*` behaviour; if the suite exposes a data-layer defect, describe it in HANDOFF under "Deviations from plan"/"Known issues" for a `9998_*` migration and mark the step as `test.fixme` with the reason — never `supabase db push`/`db reset`.
- Never write a real email, key or token into a spec, `.env.example`, docs or `prompt_history.txt`. If I have not given you `E2E_*` values, write and type-check the suite, run it only in its skipped mode, and tell me exactly what to export to run it.

## Verify

- `pnpm --filter web build` → zero warnings (3.7a's standard holds).
- `pnpm --filter web test:e2e:smoke` → green including the new axe assertions (both `smoke` and `smoke-mobile`).
- Without `E2E_*`: `pnpm --filter web test:e2e:full` → every full test reported as skipped with the message naming `docs/ENV.md`; exit code 0.
- With `E2E_*` exported for the hosted project (and `BASE_URL` unset, then set to the Vercel URL): `pnpm --filter web test:e2e:full` → all steps pass in one run; afterwards the hosted `organizations` table has no row with the run tag and `auth.users` has no `example.invalid` user from the run (check in the Supabase dashboard or with a one-off `supabase-admin.ts` call). Run it twice in a row to prove idempotence.
- `ls apps/web/e2e/fixtures/small.mp3` → under 64 KB; `xxd -l 2 apps/web/e2e/fixtures/small.mp3` → `fffb`.
- Manual: keyboard-only pass through `/login` → `/admin` → church → `/o/<slug>/users` grid → toggle a checkbox with Space → the change saves; every focused element shows a visible ring.
- `docs/QA_WEB.md` audit table has a row for every route listed in Build item 7 and no cell says "missing".

proposed_additional_steps.title: Founder-triggered production smoke on every Vercel deployment
proposed_additional_steps.goal: After each production deployment the smoke suite runs automatically against the live URL (GitHub Actions `deployment_status` event, `BASE_URL` = the deployment URL) and posts a check; the founder sees red before members do.
proposed_additional_steps.prompt:
You are working in the ChurchAppCLD repository. CLAUDE.md loads `new_session_instructions.md` and `HANDOFF.md` automatically — follow the session-start checklist (new-session.sh, prompt_history.txt). Work on `main` unless I have named another branch in this session. This is step 3.12 "Founder-triggered production smoke on every Vercel deployment" of `docs/TODO.md`; read that step's 'Done when' list first. Read `docs/DEPLOY.md`, `docs/QA_WEB.md` and `.github/workflows/ci.yml` before writing code. Build ONLY this step; do not start the next one.

## Goal
A second workflow `.github/workflows/deploy-smoke.yml` runs `pnpm --filter web test:e2e:smoke` with `BASE_URL` taken from the Vercel GitHub integration's `deployment_status` event (state `success`, environment Production) and uploads the Playwright report on failure. It is blocking (not `continue-on-error`) because it never needs secrets.

## Inputs / prior state
3.7a's smoke suite supports `BASE_URL`; Vercel's GitHub App emits `deployment_status` events for the project imported in 2.5.

## Build
1. Workflow on `deployment_status`; `if: github.event.deployment_status.state == 'success' && github.event.deployment.environment == 'Production'`; checkout at `github.event.deployment.sha`; pnpm/node setup as in `ci.yml`; `playwright install --with-deps chromium`; `BASE_URL=${{ github.event.deployment_status.environment_url }} pnpm --filter web test:e2e:smoke`; upload report on failure. 2. `docs/DEPLOY.md`: describe the check and what to do when it fails (2.6 template). 3. Optional: also run on Preview with a matrix if the founder wants (documented, off by default).

## Constraints
No secrets in the workflow; smoke only (never the full suite); do not change `ci.yml` semantics.

## Verify
Push → after Vercel deploys, the new workflow appears green on the commit; a deliberate header regression on a branch preview (if enabled) turns it red.

## Finish
HANDOFF (State, CI section), tick 3.12 in `docs/TODO.md`, `session_log.md`, commit `ci: production smoke after every Vercel deployment`, push.
done_when: `.github/workflows/deploy-smoke.yml` exists and runs on `deployment_status` success for Production.
The run on the latest production deployment is green and visible on the commit.
On failure the Playwright report is attached to the run.
`docs/DEPLOY.md` explains the check and the follow-up procedure.
